decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 2531-01/MP-REV A, 2531-02/MP-REV A, 2531-03/MP-REV C, 2531-04/MP-REV B, 2531-05/MP-REV A, 2531-06/MP submitted 08/01/2013  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The two storey side and single storey rear extensions  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 59 Station Road, Hounslow.
description: Erection of a two storey side and single storey ground floor rear extension at the property
